archetypes.name: dyn-symlink-containment
archetypes.rationale: Change adds symlink-escape guards to destructive run-dir cleanup (unlink/rmtree/read/write); verify no operation can still escape the run dir.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on python/cleanup_implement_logs.py symlink containment. Confirm every per-file operation — the rglob/glob delete loops, upgrade_transcripts, strip_tally_body, and consolidate_breadcrumbs (breadcrumbs dir, larch-quiet-*.log entries, quiet.log write target) — skips any path resolving outside the run dir via _within_run_dir/_contained. Hunt for residual bypass vectors: TOCTOU between resolve() and the read/write/unlink, intermediate symlinked directory components, broken symlinks resolving outside, and write-through on quiet.log. Verify the new tests in test_cleanup_implement_logs.py actually exercise escape (external target survives) and that legitimate in-run-dir cleanup is unaffected. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
